keywords_en: a privacy EIP by Iranian exchange developers sparks debate
summary_en: Ledger's combined ERC-7730 changes merged, improving clear display of transactions and signatures in wallets. bitcoinbrisbane proposed EIP-8082, letting contracts subscribe to and react to other contracts' events with gas-bounded execution. ameensol noted a privacy EIP was written by developers from Iran's largest exchange.
